description: Land Acquisition - Baddegama, Baddegama D/S Division, Galle District and Perukkody, Delft D/S Division , Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette contains two separate declarations under Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purposes. It includes detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, locations, and surrounding properties. While it mentions a government minister's name, the primary focus is on land acquisition matters, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
